note.text: Customers who file the most support tickets also churn the most, and leadership reads that as proof support is driving people away. Those customers were already failing before they ever called in — the tickets are the smoke detector, not the fire. Cut the channel that surfaces the problem and the churn doesn't drop, it just goes dark until the invoice. Before touching any metric tied to an outcome, ask what intervention would actually sever the link — if there isn't one, the arrow only exists in the dashboard.
